examples.vi: Tôi thích công việc mới vì nó mang lại nhiều sự đa dạng.

examples.en: Adding variety to your diet helps keep you healthy.
examples.vi: Tạo sự đa dạng trong chế độ ăn uống giúp bạn giữ gìn sức khỏe.

senses.vi: sự đa dạng; tính muôn màu muôn vẻ

senses.definition: A particular sort or type of thing, plant, or animal within a larger group.

examples.en: Farmers in this region grow several different varieties of rice.
examples.vi: Nông dân ở vùng này trồng nhiều giống lúa khác nhau.

examples.en: This rare variety of rose only blooms once a year.
examples.vi: Giống hoa hồng hiếm này chỉ nở hoa mỗi năm một lần.

senses.definition: A form of theater or television entertainment made up of songs, dances, and comedy acts.

examples.en: Old variety shows included music, comedy sketches, and acrobatics.
examples.vi: Các chương trình tạp kỹ xưa bao gồm âm nhạc, hài kịch và nhào lộn.

senses.vi: chương trình tạp kỹ; tạp kỹ

thesaurus.definition: a collection containing a variety of sorts of things
noticeable heterogeneity
(biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics
a show consisting of a series of short unrelated performances
a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
a difference that is usually pleasant

vi_block: trạng thái khác nhau, trạng thái muôn màu muôn vẻ; tính chất bất đồng

wiktionary.gloss: A deviation or difference.
A specific variation of something.
An animal or plant (or a group of such animals or plants) with characteristics causing it to differ from other animals or plants of the same species; a strain or cultivar.

examples: Capsicum annuum var. glabriusculum is a variety of Capsicum annuum commonly known as chiltepin or Indian pepper.
wiktionary.gloss: A rank in a taxonomic classification below species and (if present) subspecies, and above form; hence, an organism of that rank.

examples: Near-synonym: dialect (sometimes synonymous)
wiktionary.gloss: A specific form of a language, neutral to whether that form is an accent, dialect, register, etc., and to its prestige level.

A stamp, or set of stamps, which has one or more characteristics (such as colour, paper, etc.) differing from other stamps in the same issue, especially if such differences are intentionally introduced.
A collection or number of different things.
In universal algebra: an equational class; the class of all algebraic structures of a given signature, satisfying a given set of identities.
The total number of distinct states of a system; also, the logarithm to the base 2 of the total number of distinct states of a system.

examples: Variety is the spice of life.
wiktionary.gloss: The quality of being varied; diversity.
The kind of entertainment given in variety performances or shows; also, the production of, or performance in, variety performances or shows.

idioms.gloss: Variety is what makes life interesting.
idioms.phrase: variety is the spice of life

idioms.gloss: Ordinary, common, or unexceptional.

known: variety is the spice of life

tatoeba.vi: Hầu hết người ta cần sự đa dạng.

tatoeba.en: Good points: The pleasure of disposing of enemies with a variety of combos.
tatoeba.vi: Điểm tốt: Niềm vui sướng khi được thoải mái làm gỏi đối phương bằng nhiều loại combo khác nhau.

blocks.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin vividus (“animated, spirited”), from vivere (“to live”), akin to vita (“life”), Ancient Greek βίος (bíos, “life”). The noun sense (a type of marker pen) was genericized from Bic's Vivid Marker brand.

senses.definition: very bright, strong, and clear in colour

examples.en: She wore a vivid green dress to the party.
examples.vi: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc váy màu xanh lá rực rỡ đến bữa tiệc.

senses.definition: producing very clear and detailed pictures in the mind

examples.en: I still have vivid memories of my childhood home.
examples.vi: Tôi vẫn còn những ký ức sống động về ngôi nhà thời thơ ấu của mình.

senses.definition: full of energy, interest, and excitement

examples.en: The novel gives a vivid description of city life.
examples.vi: Cuốn tiểu thuyết đem lại một bức tranh sinh động về đời sống thành thị.

thesaurus.definition: evoking lifelike images within the mind
having strong or striking color
(of color) having the highest saturation

vi_block: Chói lọi, sặc sỡ (màu sắc, ánh sáng).
Sinh động, mạnh mẽ, sâu sắc.

wiktionary.gloss: Clear, detailed, or powerful.
Bright, intense, or colourful.
Full of life; strikingly alive.

wiktionary.gloss: A felt-tipped permanent marker; a marker pen.

tatoeba.en: The event still remains vivid in my memory.
tatoeba.vi: Chuyện đó vẫn còn in sâu trong đầu tôi.
